highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.8 brings raster-pipeline safety and texture-sampling fixes to the m150 line.

bullets.detail: Corrects region-buffer sizing for subdivided conics and checks accumulation overflow. Failed runtime-shader stage construction no longer leaves executable partial pipelines with unresolved branch offsets; transformed shader child failures propagate correctly.

Disables an unsupported GLES upload format for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx. Nearest-filtered texture subsets retain clamps when magnification or fractional coordinates could otherwise sample neighboring texels, while preserving the integer-aligned fast path.
